Row.Text: A traveler's and writer's experience becomes civic memory and cultural wealth.
A Nighthawk watches over cities and protects his civilization's secrets.
Establishes faster. Eligible ordinary land and naval units trained here permanently gain +1 Movement. Purchases and upgrade inheritance still need live verification.
This city gains +4 Great Writer points per turn and +4 Culture from each Great Work of Writing.
Each of your domestic trade routes ending here grants its origin city +3 Food and +3 Production.
This city gains +50% Production toward a building or district type your civilization completed before. Does not affect units or projects.
Eligible ordinary land and naval combat units trained here receive one selectable starting promotion. Purchases and stacking with other free promotions need live verification.
Writing here has double base Tourism and +20 Gold per work. Standard writings gain +2 Culture, in addition to the +4 from Bestselling Serial.
This city gains +4 Faith and continuous normal visibility within six hexes of its center.
Ordinary recon units trained here permanently gain +2 Sight and +50% combat experience. Purchases and upgrade inheritance need live verification.
Enemy spy missions in this city suffer a -2 level modifier. Secret Guardian supersedes this with an empire-wide -3 effect.
While established, gain one level of diplomatic visibility against other met major civilizations.
While established and active, each enemy spy captured in this city grants either 300 Science or 300 Culture at random, once per case.
While established and active, enemy spies operate 3 levels lower in all your cities and your counterspies gain 2 levels. The local Investigation bonus does not stack.
